message.content:
**C♯ Major Scale**

The C♯ major scale consists of the following notes:

| Degree | Note |
|--------|------|
| 1 (tonic) | C♯ |
| 2 | D♯ |
| 3 | E♯ (enharmonic to F) |
| 4 | F♯ |
| 5 | G♯ |
| 6 | A♯ |
| 7 | B♯ (enharmonic to C) |
| 8 (octave) | C♯ |

**Pattern of intervals:** Whole‑step – Whole‑step – Half‑step – Whole‑step – Whole‑step – Whole‑step – Half‑step.

So the full scale is: **C♯ – D♯ – E♯ – F♯ – G♯ – A♯ – B♯ – C♯**.
